message.content:
**Image 1 (Desktop 1440px)**
1. **Clean, minimal & elegant?** PASS – Single glass card with subtle borders and 3 distinct columns.
2. **All numbers/labels readable?** PASS – “128+”, “42%”, “36” and their labels are fully visible.
3. **Overlap/cutoff/bugs?** PASS – No overlap; vertical dividers are clean and spacing is even.
4. **Simple & premium look?** PASS – Dark green theme feels high-end; layout is uncluttered.

**Image 2 (Mobile 375px)**
1. **Clean, minimal & elegant?** PASS – Card adapts to a single row; still looks like one cohesive unit.
2. **All numbers/labels readable?** PASS – All text is fully legible without horizontal scrolling or truncation.
3. **Overlap/cutoff/bugs?** PASS – Elements stay within the card bounds; no text wrapping issues.
4. **Simple & premium look?** PASS – Maintains the premium dark aesthetic despite the narrow width.

**Verdict:** Both views pass all checks—the stats strip is responsive, readable, and maintains a clean, premium appearance across desktop and mobile.
